answer: Give every agent its own walk. First, the operator walks 30 seconds, phone in pocket, while the accelerometer records stride, cadence, and sway as a 200 step gait print. Second, the network runs each print through a prism of stride, cadence, sway, and a delta under 2 percent flags a shared walker and refuses the second one. Third, a random recheck every 30 days demands a 20 second walk in 10 minutes, and a miss locks the identity and burns its 250 POA bond. Each fake needs its own walker at 35 dollars, so 1,000 fakes cost 35,000 dollars. A gait print is a mirror that knows one face.
